title: Digital Impacts Schema and Taxonomy (DIST) v0.0.1
description: A single-file schema for reporting the impacts of a technology estate across multiple dimensions. Each impact is recorded as an individual entry in the impacts array, allowing reporting at any level of granularity from a single top-level dimension figure down to a specific technology category.

$schema.description: The URL to the JSON schema file for the version of DIST you are using

description.description: Brief description of the organization and its technology estate.

open_corporates_url.description: Open Corporates URL for the reporting organization, providing a verifiable corporate identity (e.g. 'https://opencorporates.com/companies/gb/12345678').

country.description: A valid 2-digit ISO 3166 alpha-2 country code for the country of registration of this organization

sector.description: Primary sector, according to the SNA 2008 / ESA 2010 standard categories for national accounting.

industries.description: Industrial sector according to the ISICv5 / NACE categories.

size.description: Employee count range, based on Eurostat employment size classes.

report.description: A single impacts report covering a defined period.

reporting_unit.description: Organisational unit this report covers (e.g. 'Global Operations', 'Cloud Platform', 'Product X').

verification.description: Level of verification applied to this report.

verifier.description: Verifying organization. Required when verification is 'independently_verified'.

name.description: The name of the verifying organization

impacts.description: Individual impact measurements, organised by particular impact dimension being measured. Each dimension is optional - the absence of a dimension implies that that dimension has not been measured, not that no impact exists. For the moment DIST supports only the 'carbon' dimension - in future versions, other impacts such as 'water', 'energy', and 'health' will be added, once measurement methodology for each of these has been settled upon.

carbon.description: Array of individual co2e impact measurements. Each entry reports a single quantifiable impact. Report at whatever granularity you have data for. The absence of a category does not imply that the impact of that category is 0, but that not measurement is available. Categories with a 0 impact should be explicitly listed

categories.description: Array of category identiers from the DIST taxonomy.

value.description: The measured or estimated impact value. An explicit 'null' here indidates that an impact exists, but could not be measured, and therefore should be interpreted as 'unknown', rather than 'zero'.

unit.description: Unit of measurement. Should be spelled out clearly (e.g. 'kgCO2e', 'kWh', 'litres', 'm3', 'kg', 'hectares', 'years'). Defined by the methodology but stated here for transparency.

methodology_description.description: Human-readable description of the methodology used to calculate this value (e.g. 'Cloud Carbon Footprinting tool', 'Manufacturer LCA data', 'WRI Aqueduct water stress assessment').

anyOf.description: "high": Calculations that use real, device-specific primary data (manufacturer Product Carbon Footprint datasheets, actual billing or usage data) with clear, documented methodology count as high confidence numbers.

"medium": If “high” is referring to specific products, primary data, and independent verification or peer review, you can think of "medium" as following similar principles but where at least one generalisation has had to have been applied.
"low": Finally "low" confidence calculations involve model-on-model stacking, very uncertain activity data, or proxies used to substitute for a different provider entirely.

confidence.description: Confidence in the reported value, this can be classified as low, medium, or high, depending on the specific methodology used, following the guidelines at https://dist.greenweb.org/schema/confidence.

notes.description: Supporting notes: assumptions, scope boundaries, limitations, or anything a reader needs to interpret this value correctly.

data_sources.description: References to data sources used (URLs, document names, database identifiers).

category.description: An impact category from the DIST taxonomy: https://dist.greenweb.org/taxonomy

industry.description: An industrial sector, from the ISICv5 / NACE taxonomy
